data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 阳台上的盆栽
data.description: 清晨的阳台上，她给窗边的盆栽浇水，等泥土湿透后才放下水壶。
data.action: watering a potted plant on the balcony
data.promptProse: On a narrow brick balcony on a clear morning, Bazett holds a green metal watering can, carefully hydrating a terracotta pot of red geraniums on the sill. Soft morning sunlight illuminates the red-brick railings, with city rooftops and church steeples stretching quietly into the distance.
